name: Claude Code v2.1.208-209 — Screen Reader Mode, Vim Remaps, Background Agents Auto-PR, Mouse Support
hook: Two releases landed today (July 14). v2.1.208 adds opt-in screen reader mode (--ax-screen-reader or CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER=1), vimInsertModeRemaps setting for jj→Escape sequences, and CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER for corporate launcher environments. The biggest workflow change: background agents in worktrees now automatically commit, push, and open a draft PR when they finish code work — no more 'do you want to push?' interrupts. v2.1.209 fixes /model dialogs blocked in background sessions. Also: fast mode auto-restores, replies to background agents no longer lost on delivery failure.

name: shareAI-lab/learn-claude-code — ~68K Stars; "Bash Is All You Need"; Nano Claude Code-Like Agent Harness
hook: ~68K stars (66K confirmed in June, growing) on a repo that builds a Claude Code-like terminal agent from scratch — one loop, one Bash tool. The 20-chapter curriculum (s01–s20 in root-level folders) walks from zero to a working harness: each chapter has a narrative README, runnable code.py, translations, and diagrams. The core thesis is 'Agent = Model + Harness' and a single generalized Bash tool replaces the 40+ tool explosion. Used heavily for understanding how Claude Code itself works under the hood.

name: Statewright — Visual State Machines That Make AI Agents Reliable; Show HN; Apache 2.0
hook: Show HN this week: a Rust engine that enforces state machine definitions on AI agents — tools are gated per state, not suggested. Instead of giving Claude 40+ tools and hoping, you define states (plan, implement, review, deploy) and the engine hard-blocks disallowed tools for each state. A 5-task SWE-bench subset showed two local models (13.8GB and 19.9GB) go from 2/10 to 10/10 with constraints enabled; Haiku and Sonnet also punch above weight. Integrates with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode, and Pi via MCP. Visual editor to design workflows; managed cloud at statewright.ai or self-host. Engine + agent layer Apache 2.0.

name: zilliztech/claude-context — 11.9K Stars; Semantic Code Search MCP; ~40% Token Reduction
hook: Zilliz's MCP server indexes your codebase into a local vector + BM25 hybrid search engine (AST-aware chunking per language, incremental Merkle-tree indexing) so Claude Code queries 'all relevant code' rather than reading entire file trees. Measured ~40% token reduction on large codebases. 11.9K stars, 890 forks, with 3,725 stars gained in a single trending week. Supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cline, Roo Code, Windsurf, and Augment. 14 languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, and C++.

name: TrendsMCP — One MCP Server; 20+ Live Trend Sources (Google, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, npm, Steam…); Free Tier
hook: Single MCP server that gives Claude Code live trend data from 20+ sources: Google Trends (5-year weekly history or 30-day daily), TikTok trending hashtags, YouTube trending, Reddit hot posts, Amazon best sellers, App Store top charts, Google Play, Steam most played, GitHub trending repos, Wikipedia trending, news sentiment, web traffic, and more. One API key covers every source. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, and any MCP-compatible client. Free tier covers 100 requests/month; paid plans available at trendsmcp.ai.

name: jrenaldi79/sidecar — Parallel AI Window for Claude Code; Fork to Gemini/GPT/DeepSeek via OpenRouter; Fold Results Back
hook: A CLI companion that reads your live Claude Code session from ~/.claude/projects/[project]/[session].jsonl and routes it in parallel to any OpenRouter-supported model (Gemini, GPT-4o, DeepSeek, etc.). Three modes: Chat (fact-check + human review), Plan (strict read-only, no writes), Build (full autonomy). Hit Cmd+Shift+F to FOLD — generates a structured diff summary you can approve and apply back to the main session. Surfaces systematic blind spots: if Claude missed an edge case that Gemini catches, you see it. MCP server auto-registered for Claude Desktop and Cowork.

name: VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents — 20.5K Stars; 100+ Specialized Claude Code Subagents
hook: 100+ drop-in Claude Code subagent definitions across 10 categories: core development, language specialists (TypeScript wizard, Python architect, Go craftsman…), infra, quality & security, data & AI, developer experience, specialized domains, business/product, meta-orchestration, and research. Each subagent runs in its own isolated context window with domain-specific instructions and granular tool permissions — preventing cross-task contamination and scope creep. 20.5K stars. CLAUDE.md wires them in as a flat directory Claude can delegate to.

name: Graphify — ~84K Stars; v0.9.16; Day 9 of Daily Release Cadence; PostgreSQL Live Schema Introspection
hook: Daily release cadence continues through Week 2. The core proposition — tree-sitter AST parsing into a local queryable knowledge graph at 71.5x average token reduction (1.7K tokens per query vs 123K naive file reads) — has been joined this week by PostgreSQL live schema introspection (graph refreshes automatically on schema changes) and Streamable HTTP MCP transport for remote deployments. YC S26, growing ~2K stars/day. Rivals Graphify for token reduction use cases, but with a database-aware persistent agent memory angle.
install: uv tool install graphifyy && graphify install

name: thedotmack/claude-mem — ~87K Stars; Day 5; New /recall Command Surfaces Memories Without Injecting Them
hook: claude-mem v13.11 adds /recall — a read-only command that queries the ChromaDB + SQLite memory store and shows what the agent knows about a topic without injecting it into the active session context. Useful for auditing what claude-mem has retained before starting a sensitive task. Five session lifecycle hooks (SessionStart through SessionEnd) continue to capture, AI-compress, and retrieve semantically relevant context. ~87K stars. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, and OpenCode.
